profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Software developer/analyst/support with experience in designing, constructing, documenting, testing, implementing, and supporting applications and solutions for tasks ranging from data visualization, accounting, forecasting, and utility system planning and operation.  Problem solver and analyst with engineering background. Technical and business trainer with competence in teaching as a classroom instructor and providing on-site support and training.

Specialties: Product/software support, training, .NET C#/VB, C/C++, FORTRAN, XML, SQL

positions.title: Owner & Freelance Software Developer
positions.description: Development in .NET and SQL Server for a startup marketing, ecommerce web site. Mostly back end with some front end development.

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description: Provide help desk support for asset accounting software through code review, technical analysis, data inspection and process knowledge with Power Builder and Oracle.

positions.title: GIS Systems Analyst
positions.description: Support company wide distribution GIS (Geographical Information Systems) with installation, development and maintenance with ESRI, ArcFM, Oracle, C++, .NET (C#/VB)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Mobile, back office and web programming with .NET (ASP, C#, VB), XML, SQL (DB2 & SQL Server)

positions.title: Software Support/Development
positions.description: Software support and development. Software training.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: IT and systems support for Meredith Corp

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Performed the computer modeling for a research project
